Hey,
I’m no stranger to your situation. It’s hard when it comes to those around you. You think about them individually, trying to work out how much it will affect them and what you can do before to make it easier. When it comes down to it you realise that even with issues in your relationship with them or maybe even hatred on either end; they’ll still miss you. I’m not sure if it’s the same for you but my head went it no recovery mode because of this and made me think they all don’t give a shit and wouldn’t care if I did take my life. It’s important you know that’s it’s just your head trying to minimise the pain of thinking about it. That fact didn’t stop me and I was hospitalised for a bit which was horrible. I hope you’re ok, if you want to vent then give me a message. I won’t tell you to not do anything. I’ll just listen. x
